tagline: A more thoughtful way to explore Kyoto, one step at a time.
welcomeBody: Discover Kyoto on foot, collect stamps and respect the places you visit.
nicknameHint: Saved only on this device. You can change it later.
homeBody: Explore three map-checked Kyoto walks, with honest access notes and optional GPS or Demo Mode.
homeValueTitle: A gentler way through the city
homeValueBody: Three map-checked walks now show public corridors, nearby places, and access considerations.
homeComingBody: Choose a walk, collect its stamps and spend demo coins on a fictional coupon.
mapBody: Explore Kyoto on a real, interactive map. Choose live GPS or a simulated Kyoto point.
mapExploreHint: Drag to explore Kyoto. Pinch or use +/− to zoom.
mapLoadError: The Kyoto map could not load. You can still browse the stored walks.
mapSearchPreviewBody: Choose a mapped walk or search a place name.
mapSearchNoResults: No mapped walk matches that search. Try Yasaka, river, or Maruyama.
mapCategoryPreviewBody: Choose another theme. Themes without a validated walk show an empty state.
mapSampleLocationLabel: Sample map point, not your GPS location
mapListPreviewBody: The walk list shows verified places and access notes.
mapCanvasCaption: Real geography and room to wander.
settingsBody: Your name and language stay on this device.
aboutBody: Explore three map-checked Kyoto walks with optional GPS or simulated movement. Progress is saved in this browser. Routes await field review. All coins and coupons are fictional.
onboardingReturn: Your welcome screen is saved locally.
locationStatusOff: No location selected. Choose GPS or Demo Mode.
locationStatusRequesting: Waiting for browser location permission and a fix…
locationStatusLowAccuracy: Live GPS is imprecise (±{accuracy} m). Your position may be off.
locationStatusOutsideKyoto: Outside Kyoto. Your actual location is shown (±{accuracy} m).
locationStatusDenied: Location permission denied. Retry or use Demo Mode.
locationStatusTimeout: Location timed out. Retry or use Demo Mode.
locationStatusUnavailable: Location unavailable. Check browser support and HTTPS.
locationStatusPaused: GPS stopped outside Map. Tap Use My Location to resume.
mapDemoMarkerLabel: Simulated Kyoto location, not your GPS position
locationSettingsHint: Turning Demo Mode off keeps GPS off. Recenter opens Map; paused live GPS needs a new Use My Location tap.
locationStatusLowAccuracyOutside: Live GPS is imprecise (±{accuracy} m) and reports a position outside Kyoto.
routesEmpty: No validated walk matches this search or category yet.
routesMapChecked: These walks follow map-checked pedestrian ways. Check current signs and conditions before walking.
routesCommunityNotConsulted: Community representatives have not reviewed this place entry. Respect current signs and local access rules.
routesSearchHint: Try “river under 10 minutes” or a place name. Suggestions use only stored walks.
routesSearchMatched: Stored walks matching your place, theme, or time terms.
routesSearchFallback: No verified walk matches every part of that request. These are the available map-checked walks; check their details before choosing.
gameGpsHint: Use live GPS within {radius} m, with a fresh fix accurate to ±{accuracy} m.
gameBonus: Finish all stops for a {coins}-coin completion bonus.
gameDisclosure: These fictional coupons spend demo coins and have no cash or redemption value.
gameNoClaims: Your claimed coupons will appear here.
gameEarned: All stamps collected. Completion bonus: {coins} demo coins.
gameResetBody: Clear all walks, stamps, demo coins and coupon claims on this browser? Your nickname and language will be kept.
gamePeak: Sample busy period (+{percent}% per demo stamp)
gameStopHint: Keep the stamps and coins already earned and end this walk?
